comment: Researcher reviewed and accepts the technical recovery conclusion within the stated S0 evidence limits.
Full is the first future evaluation condition; this decision does not authorize a Full rollout in this round.
Twenty-four exploratory candidate episodes are accepted as a draft, not as a frozen valid set.
Four draft bins are 100-200m, 200-300m, 300-400m, and 400-550m, six candidates each; server coordinates must determine final bins.

Join JSON pos, SHP geometry, SHP lat/lon attributes, and runtime coordinate use; snapped-to-road differences are not automatically corruption. Return any task, goal, or success-boundary changing discrepancy for review.
A separate fixed single-goal adapter may be prepared and smoke-tested; do not modify legacy source. Include a semantics diff against evaluate() and CourierGame.
Success is the first position strictly less than 100m from the fixed goal, with immediate termination; report any different legacy boundary.
Use 1000 environment actions as this pilot cap; do not describe it as a complete historical evaluation protocol.
Future Full may use categorical sampling with frozen seeds; no PPO call is authorized in this round.
Server may run environment/data/adapter checks with predetermined actions and no PPO loading or policy rollout.
A complete Full policy rollout requires separate researcher authorization after environment smoke review.
